comment: Besik is an extremely nice person, cares deeply about her students, and is always available and eager to help. The only thing is the actual content of OM is incredibly mundane, and without a doubt the most boring course I've ever taken. I think she is aware of this and does her best to make it engaging. If you need to take OM, 100% take Besik.
Not like a free A, but if you do your best then it is possible to get an A.

Dr. Besik is the best option for OM. While the course content is a little mundane she makes the class enjoyable as possible. 1 midterm and 1 final which make up have 55% of your grade, Somewhat difficult but nothing "surprises."

TAKE OM WITH BESIK! She is so nice and makes the material interesting. There is a lot of homework but this contributes to a lot of your grade so it's easy to do well. Quizzes and Exams are pretty much exactly like the problem sets and handouts. She can be a little scattered at times but overall studying for tests was easy.

I really enjoyed her class this semester.  She's really caring and understanding and makes a bland topic tolerable.  The material is easy to understand if you pay attention during lectures and do the problem sets.  She's accessible outside of class and is generous with extensions.  There is a textbook but her slides are all you need.
